title: PaperIO semi auto win round
features:
If you change line 3 to not have "and v.Color ~= Color3.fromRGB(163,162,165)" it will paint the entire board. This can be very laggy and will take a long time to work, it's not a good idea in my opinion but it's there if you want it.

How to use:
1) Execute the script during a round. This will paint everyones tiles.
2) Walk out and back in of a tile you already own (eg your starting tile)
3) This will paint over all the highlighted tiles
-- This may need one or two goes as sometimes people paint more than this can claim
script:
for i,v in ipairs(game.Workspace.Map:GetChildren()) do
   task.spawn(function()
       if v.Color ~= game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.ColorPercent.List.BarSelf.BackgroundColor3 and v.Color ~= Color3.fromRGB(163,162,165) then
           firetouchinterest(game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.BlockTouchPart,v,0)
           task.wait()
           firetouchinterest(game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.BlockTouchPart,v,1)
       end
   end)
end
